prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity north-star composition for a desktop utility app
Primary request: Design the complete 600 by 780 desktop window for Clickity, a modern cross-platform autoclicker used primarily during gaming. Use the approved Quick Panel visual world: carbon #17191d and graphite #25282e surfaces, warm off-white #f4f4f0 type, chartreuse #b9e44c active state, steel #737983 secondary marks; layered overlay-tray depth, broad selection rails, chunky segmented toggles, strong spacing, medium rounded corners, matte surfaces, no glow. Composition A — Ready First: the top 30 percent is a commanding ready/running panel with an oversized status symbol, the sentence “Ready when you are,” a concise interval summary, and a large chartreuse “Start clicking” control. Below it, arrange Click interval, Mouse button, Repeat, Cursor position, and Start / stop shortcut as broad controller-friendly rows. Fixed X/Y coordinates appear as a contextual expansion beneath Cursor position. Preserve all existing features and validation space.
Composition/framing: straight-on portrait desktop application, exact full window visible, no device hardware, no surrounding scene. High fidelity and production-plausible, with clear focus states and minimum comfortable target sizes.
Typography: compact modern humanist sans with rounded terminals; numerals may use a slightly narrower companion. Strong scale contrast without oversized marketing typography.
Exact interface text to render where legible: “Clickity”, “Clicks, right on cue.”, “Ready when you are”, “Start clicking”, “Click interval”, “Every 1 second”, “Mouse button”, “Left”, “Middle”, “Right”, “Repeat”, “Count”, “Until stopped”, “Cursor position”, “Follow cursor”, “Fixed position”, “Capture”, “Start / stop shortcut”, “F6”. Do not add other claims or capabilities.
Constraints: This is an operating interface, not a landing page. Make the quickest path visually dominant while keeping every current setting findable. No sidebar navigation. No invented presets, profiles, stats, accounts, cloud features, or game integrations.
Avoid: OP Auto Clicker imitation, Windows legacy controls, generic neon RGB gamer dashboard, glassmorphism, gradients, glow, glossy 3D, bento-card collage, excessive pills, tiny text, marketing copy, watermark.
